### Anonymous RPC & SMB

I attempted anonymous (and guest) RPC and SMB access to no avail:

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/SL-VM11-AnonymousRpcSmb.png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Web Server (Port 80)

The web server immediately asks for credentials to access:

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/SL-VM11-80_LoginPopup.png" alt=""><figcaption><p>Login popup</p></figcaption></figure>

#### No Login

It is possible to load _a page_ by clicking `Cancel` but I am unsure this is _the same page_ that would be seen if I had a valid sign in:

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/SL-VM11-80NoLoginHome.png" alt=""><figcaption><p>Home page seen with no login</p></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/SL-VM11-80_NoLogin_Privacy.png" alt=""><figcaption><p>Privacy policy page as seen with no login</p></figcaption></figure>

At this point I have no credentials so I try a few default guesses but none of them work. Perhaps some spraying could be done with Hydra. But for now I move on.

### Port 5900

Port 5900 appears to be VNC

I attempt connecting to it with `vncviewer` as suggested [by HackTricks](https://book.hacktricks.xyz/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-vnc) but I accidentally lock myself out:

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/SL-VM11-VncviewerLockout.png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

I will have to wait a bit before trying again to see if this is temporary.
